R301.note: Adds field_index >= MAX_FIELDS check right before the sink and returns -1, preserving the existing 0/-1 contract.

R302.note: Right shape (auth interceptor + resource-ownership check before delete) but the code imports both "metadata" and "google.golang.org/grpc/metadata" (colliding names) and uses fmt.Errorf without importing fmt, so it would not compile as written; token validation is an explicit non-functional stub that accepts any non-empty token and always resolves to the same hardcoded user id.

R303.note: Canonicalizes the base dir, rejects any filename with separators/traversal, and verifies containment via startsWith; the thrown IOException falls into the method's existing broad catch, preserving original error handling.

R304.note: random_int() is the correct CSPRNG replacement for mt_rand(); same (seed, seed+999999) range and return usage preserved.

R305.note: Hand-rolled RESP fix uses len(bio)/len(key) (character count) as the byte-length prefix; a bio with multi-byte UTF-8 characters miscounts the prefix and can still desync/inject. The 'preferred' redis-py alternative silently returns a hardcoded b'+OK\r\n' instead of the real server response.

R306.note: @fastify/csrf-protection registered and its hook added to preHandler after auth; the resulting requirement that clients supply a CSRF token is the intended, disclosed effect of the fix.

R307.note: snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "%s:%s", ...) with a truncation check exactly implements the required reject-rather-than-truncate contract.

R308.note: Swaps the branches (isAdmin() -> all, else -> owner-scoped) exactly as required, without adding a new gate.

R309.note: Captures bytesSent() into a local before resourcePtr.reset(), then returns the captured value; matches the function's contract.

R310.note: Removes the is_staff widening so all users get the owner-scoped queryset, consistent with IsTicketOwner being the sole access rule (no assignment mechanism exists to otherwise preserve for staff).

R311.note: resolve_entities=False closes XXE; added no_network/load_dtd are defense-in-depth and don't change normal parsing/findtext behavior.

R312.note: Replaces str(e) with a generic message and logs full detail server-side via logger.error(exc_info=True); status code and JSON key preserved.

R313.note: Sniffs real bytes via http.DetectContentType, allowlists the detected type, rewinds before saving, and stores under a random name returned to the caller; the added MaxBytesReader size cap is disclosed.

R314.note: Rejects separators/'..' outright, then canonicalizes and checks containment with a trailing-separator comparison; legitimate simple filenames pass unchanged.

R315.note: OdbcCommand with a '?' placeholder and bound parameter closes the injection; Odbc binds positionally so the parameter name is immaterial. Same return type/shape preserved.

R316.note: ProcessBuilder with a separate argument array plus a leading-dash/allowlist check on host closes both shell and flag-injection paths; same ping invocation semantics preserved.

R317.note: Per-category method allowlist validated before returning [handler, method] blocks any method not explicitly registered; matches the scenario's single legitimate method exactly.

R318.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode() applied to both orderId and customerNote is the correct fix (the write-up mislabels this already-encoded snippet under 'Source' rather than only under 'Fix', but the actual proposed change is correct and complete).

R319.note: mathjs's own docs/history (e.g. CVE-2022-24816) note math.evaluate() is not a hardened sandbox against fully untrusted expressions; the write-up gives no version floor or scope/function restriction, so arbitrary-code-execution risk isn't fully closed for this sink.

R320.note: FromSql(FormattableString) auto-parameterizes every interpolated hole (EF Core 7+, correctly noted); empty term still produces LIKE '%%' scoped by tenant, preserving the required behavior.

R321.note: th:text applies Thymeleaf's context-aware HTML escaping in place of unescaped th:utext; no other behavior changed.

R322.note: Named replacements (:startDate/:endDate) bind values safely via Sequelize; identical query semantics and response shape preserved.

R323.note: StackExchange.Redis HashSet() sends length-prefixed RESP arguments, closing the CRLF injection; the constructor's dependency change (Socket -> IDatabase) is fully visible in the rewritten file, not hidden.

R324.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes() replaces the seeded System.Random; write-up explicitly discloses the seed parameter is no longer used/needed.

R325.note: Route correctly scopes the lookup by req.user.id, but the shown loadProjectExport calls an undefined 'db' object that is never imported or defined in the file, so as written it throws at runtime on every call; presented as an illustrative/mock pattern but not clearly flagged as non-functional.

R326.note: self.get_object() restores DRF's queryset scoping plus has_object_permission(), giving identical 404s for missing vs. unauthorized invoices; avoids the case's named check_object_permissions-after-lookup trap.

R327.note: Captures node->next into a local before free(node), then advances with the saved pointer; exact intended fix, traversal order and refresh calls preserved.

R328.note: Pillow-based verify+reopen+re-encode with a random filename correctly sniffs and closes the sink; moving storage outside static/uploads (disclosed) removes the app's only shown way to serve the file back with no replacement retrieval route provided.

R329.note: Passes the real allocated requestedCapacity into write_field instead of the stale MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY constant; exact intended fix, and write_field's own reject-on-overflow logic is left untouched.

R330.note: Jakarta Mail Transport/MimeMessage replaces manual RCPT string construction, closing the CRLF injection. Unconditionally setting mail.smtp.starttls.required=true is not disclosed as a prerequisite and could silently break delivery if the internal relay lacks STARTTLS.

R331.note: secure=True closes the finding; the added samesite='Lax' is disclosed and does not block normal session-cookie use.

R332.note: Loops stream.Read() to fill the full 8-byte header (or reject as too small) before comparing signatures, directly closing the short-read bypass; response shape unchanged on success.

R333.note: Allowlist checks extension plus client-supplied mimetype, but path.extname() only inspects the last extension, so 'shell.php.jpg' still passes despite the write-up's own explanation naming double extensions as an attack it means to close; no magic-byte content-sniffing was added.

R334.note: Inserts the '--' end-of-options marker before user-controlled filenames, exactly matching the required fix; entries not starting with '-' still archive normally.

R335.note: mysqli_prepare/bind_param('s')/get_result replaces string concatenation; identical return contract and error handling preserved.

R336.note: Removes the stale [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] override so the app's global AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter applies again.

R337.note: Identical correct fix to the same case: captures next pointer before free() and advances with it, traversal order and free-once guarantee preserved.

R338.note: CGI::escapeHTML() applied to both ticket_subject and customer_reply before concatenation, closing the injection points actually rendered into the page.

R339.note: Direct boolean comparison (=== 'premium') replaces assert() on a concatenated string, removing the code-execution path regardless of PHP version/ini settings; access outcome for premium vs. non-premium preserved.

R340.note: Argument-array + shell=False is the right general principle, but passing the .bat path directly as argv[0] with shell=False fails to launch on Windows (CreateProcess cannot execute non-PE batch files without cmd.exe - WinError 193), silently breaking the endpoint for every legitimate call on the case's own target platform; the correct invocation needs ['cmd.exe','/c',bat_path,...].
